question: How do yajna-remnant nectar eaters reach eternal brahman?
premises: yajna-remnant nectar eaters go to eternal brahman
sacrifice nourishes faculties and leaves self-rest
inference: Sacrificial remainder becomes nectar that unites practitioners with brahman.
plain_english: Those who eat the nectar left from sacrifice go to eternal brahman; without sacrifice there is no world, and sacrifice nourishes the faculties while leaving self-rest.
